probe_definitions_frozen.population: the fourteen bundles listed in probe_bundle_list PLUS the one prior-cycle control bundle; each row of each bundle with counter_status not in (null, 'none') is a status-bearing row; the probe's claim-bearing rows are the rows with counter_evidence_verified exactly true

prior_cycle_control.role: stability control: the same probe applied to the prior accepted head's flagship slice so a defect that appears only on the new head is distinguishable from one already present

defect_predicates.D1_empty_evidence: counter_evidence is null, empty, or whitespace-only on a counter_evidence_verified=true row
defect_predicates.D2_letterhead_zone: counter_evidence is a verbatim substring of the row's own full_text AND the offset of its first occurrence is < LETTERHEAD_ZONE_OFFSET_MAX
defect_predicates.D3_markup_residue: counter_evidence contains any of the frozen markup tokens MARKUP_TOKENS
defect_predicates.D4_language_marker_mismatch: the row language is one of LANGUAGE_MARKER_SETS and the evidence contains at least MIN_MARKER_HITS marker tokens of a DIFFERENT frozen language set and ZERO marker tokens of its own language set

evidence_grounding_field.note: grounding is checked against the row's own full_text, then snippet, then regeste, in that order; the field that grounds the evidence is recorded, and full_text being empty (lazy) is disclosed rather than counted as ungrounded

probe_definitions_frozen.row_class_rule: a verified row is COUNTER_REASONING if and only if none of D1-D4 fire; otherwise its class is the concatenation of the fired defect codes

probe_is_not_a_frozen_bar.statement: THIS PROBE SCORES NO FROZEN BAR. Its population is the product's own shipped slice bundles, which are NOT the RULES_LABEL population (the packet-of-record 39319405429). The frozen rubrics RULES_LABEL.json and RULES_GEOMETRY.json are re-hashed REPORTED-ONLY and are never applied, edited or re-derived here. No abstention semantics, support rate or geometry criterion of the frozen scorer is computed, pre-declared or implied (factory-wide requirement 22).

success_rules_frozen.H1: PASS if n_divergent == 0 and n_not_found == 0 across the frozen currency quantity list (dual float verdicts published per the accepted D-A convention: strict 1e-6 AND applied precision-matched 5e-4).
success_rules_frozen.H2: H2 SURVIVES if zero verified rows fire any of D1-D4 across all fifteen probe/control bundles. H2 FALSIFIED otherwise. Either way the result is preserved.
success_rules_frozen.H3: PASS if the re-run exits 1 (PRODUCT_FALSIFIED) with failed_gates equal to the accepted four-gate set and empty engine input_drift.
success_rules_frozen.H4: PASS if the planner sha equals 9764a37e..., the remedy-A ordering predicate holds, the degradation marker predicate holds with rate 1.0, and the re-pinned pipeline.py equals 265b82ac... (the value already disclosed as product-advance drift at run 40012474431 and now adopted as the new baseline of record under THIS run id).

cycle_verdict.PASS_NO_FALSIFICATION: exit 0 - H1 confirmed, H3 reproduced, H4 holds, all controls pass, requirement-4 lineage complete. H2 may still be FALSIFIED: a falsified H2 is recorded as an accepted-class NEGATIVE result and is disclosed in the verdict block, because it is a content defect on the product's own artifacts and NOT a divergence of a published quantity.
cycle_verdict.MATERIAL_DIVERGENCE: exit 1 - any currency quantity DIVERGENT, OR the falsification re-run changes verdict class, OR a must-hold planner/degradation pin drifts
cycle_verdict.NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS: exit 2 - a frozen input drifted, a control failed, a required artifact is missing, or the subprocess was not executable
